description.text: 1.Program Overview The graduates will have solid foundation for specialty knowledge and have creative ability to fulfill the requirement of engineering practice in the future. After the training of fundamental principles and knowledge in the discipline of civil engineering as a qualified engineering, the graduates will be cultivated to be competent for the professional position such as construction, structural design, engineering investigation, management, engineering consulting, education, research and development in the engineering fields of civil architecture, highway, bridge, tunnel as well as railway. 2.Teaching Objectives Be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. 3.Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction,Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese 4.Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. 5.Duration 4 Years 6.Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted BachelorDegree of Civil EngineeringbyNortheastern University 7.Future Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Northeastern University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. High school's certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 25. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 3. Applicants must have high school certificate or will high school certificate by September 2015.
